Sect: Independent (Bloodline)

The Daughters of Cacophony are an exclusively female bloodline of musicians and performers, said by some to have split from the Toreador or Malkavian clans, though their true origin remains a mystery tinged with myths of faerie influence. They devote themselves entirely to song and performance, largely indifferent to the political maneuvers of the Jyhad, and most hold only nominal Camarilla ties for the patronage it offers.

Disciplines: Fortitude, Melpominee, Presence

Advantage: Daughters of Cacophony begin with at least one level of Performance: Singing for free, along with an additional level of a related Ability or Influence reflecting their musical talent.

Disadvantage: The constant inner music that haunts the Sirens leaves them partially deaf to the world, imposing a penalty on perception-based tests and capping how many perception-related Mental Traits they may possess.

Organization: An entirely female bloodline that historically purged a small male offshoot known as the Sons of Discord; members gather informally around performance venues and patrons.
